answer: Before the stamp comes a toll of 77 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Every entry must show Millbound coriander grower hearth patent before the ledger opens, because a patent coriander growers file after herb garden reviews. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. The tally keeps vine. Every comet is counted once. One relic, one entry.
